AI

Prep ↔ AI.

Two directions, same idea. Let prep use AI to draft and grade cards for you, powered by whichever provider this deploy or your own key supplies. Or let an outside agent use prep, managing decks from wherever you work.

Free AI included

Your own key is active and takes priority. Remove it to fall back to the included free AI.

Free AI runs on a third-party inference service (currently Hetzner's experimental API). Prompts and card content you send through AI features leave this deploy and are processed there. The provider publishes no data-use or retention statement for this API. If that's not acceptable, add your own API key below: your key means your provider, your terms.

Local install only

Process-wide Claude subscription not connected ›

Heads up: this configures a single OAuth token at the process level — every user signed in to this prep install will be able to run AI calls against the connected Max subscription. Use it on personal / single-user installs only. For multi-user instances, set each user up with their own Claude subscription token in the row above.

  1. On any machine where you have Claude Code installed and signed in, run: 
    claude setup-token
  2. Authenticate in the browser when it opens, then copy the token it prints to the terminal. Starts with sk-ant-oat01-; valid for a year.
  3. Paste the token here and click Connect.

Connect via MCP

Your AI agent talks to prep over HTTP via the Model Context Protocol. Three steps:

  1. Mint a token on the API tokens page. The full token is shown once; copy it before leaving.
  2. Add prep as an MCP server in your client.
    Claude Code (CLI) 
    claude mcp add --transport http prep \
  https://prepcards.app/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer prep_pat_..."
    Claude Desktop

    Edit claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit config) and add: 

    {
  "mcpServers": {
    "prep": {
      "url": "https://prepcards.app/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer prep_pat_..."
      }
    }
  }
}

    Restart Claude Desktop after saving.

    Other MCP-aware clients

    Point the client at https://prepcards.app/mcp (HTTP transport, JSON-RPC 2.0). Pass the token as Authorization: Bearer prep_pat_….

  3. Use it. Your agent gets a tool catalog covering nearly every read/write on your decks + cards — imports, exports, rename, pin, suspend, the lot. Full reference is in /llms.txt (the agent-discovery manifest) and /docs (Swagger UI).

Install prep on your home screen.

Faster open, offline-tolerant, push-notified when a stack of cards comes due.

  1. Tap the Share button in the Safari toolbar.
  2. Scroll and pick Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add.

Tap Install prep below and your browser will offer to add it to your home screen.

On iPhone and iPad, only the system Safari browser can install web apps. Open this page in Safari and tap the Install prep pill at the bottom to continue.

Your browser doesn't support installing this as an app. Try Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
